A '''neutron emitter''' was a type of weapon that could kill most lifeforms. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] used them during the [[Battle of Corellia]], targeting any [[rocket tram]]s that tried to leave the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] as a way of blockading the region.
